fusions.name: Cutpurse's Finish
fusions.desc: Finishes an enemy at or below 25% health for 16 damage, adding 1.4 times the remaining damage of every affliction you have on it and using them up. Each hit has a 50% chance to leave the target [Blunted] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: False Opening
fusions.desc: A feint into a swing that deals 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks them back 2 tiles. Each has a 40% chance to be confused for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Turned Aside
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 60% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and each such blow has a 40% chance to confuse them for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Played Hurt
fusions.desc: When anything other than fire hurts you, your critical hit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 6 seconds.
